tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i lam dus 'bring po'i nyams len blo gsal bde 'jug bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag
༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i lam dus 'bring po'i nyams len blo gsal bde 'jug bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i lam dus 'bring po'i nyams len blo gsal bde 'jug bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//

de la 'dir bla ma las kyai rdo rje'i rgyu lam gyi dbang legs par thob pa'i rjes su rang nyid kyis lam dus rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum mam/ tha na'ang thun gnyis su chag med du nyams su len pa la/ rgyas bsdus kyi rnam dbye shes dgos pas/ skabs su brel ba'i stabs sam/ thugs dam gzhan lci bas bsdus pa byed dgos byung na/ mngon rtogs 'bring po sngon du btang nas dbang len/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa// zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/

rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa am̐ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/ lam dus thun gnyis gsum len na rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ma brjod kyang chog sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba/ de'ang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu/ chang zung dang mchog ma la yam̐ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/

grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang bas dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo/ tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags zangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥'/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha na/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon du am̐ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/

nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra mahā rā ga su khan+da da/ tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa/ tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya kaḥkha ga mu kha e/ kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun dur+ha badz+ra dhṛka ces gsang ba'i gnas su grag pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas saṅgai/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar yi ges slebs pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi shes pa mtshams gyi lha mo bzhir 'phos te glus bskul bar bsams shing*/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/

g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka /drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ de rnams las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang dang*/

bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar nam̐ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ spro na/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes pas bstod/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel te/

oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang*/ gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad de zhags mig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin pa la reg pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams nas thim/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī bhan+dha bam̐/ zhes dang*/ bai tā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'dres/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa sham̐ ku ru hoḥces dang*/ ghasma rī ljang gu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra byung bas/ dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam// ༈ /zab mo lus dkyil ni/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañca re khā/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i ām̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐/ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ham̐/

gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor blta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau rī/ rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri bai tā lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon par stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyang sku dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin stong gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ma mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// zhes dang*/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha'i gtso bo'i zhal nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis//

zhes gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su rang gis brjod/ de'i bsgom don ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin dang*/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin can re rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyi phyag g.yas dang g.yon du gtad pas/ rang gi sems 'di nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs skye 'gag dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems su byin gyis brlabs te de'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi ngag 'di nyid kyang grag stong skye 'gag dang bral ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung yan lag drug cur byin gyis brlabs te de'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi lus 'di nyid kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po yum snyems ma dkar mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i mos pa byed/ bsdu na/ rang gi sems dang*/ ngag dang*/ lus gsum rim bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom/ bsgom don 'di ma chad pa gal che/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsang dbang ni/ dbang lha'i gtso bo bla ma yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi ljags thog tu gnang ste/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su rang gis brjod/ bsgom don ni/ byang chub kyi sems rang gi mgrin pa nas song ste lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas/ dus gsum las gyur pa'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags te gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam/

rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag sher dbang ni/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i sku'i cha las mtshan ldan gyi rten phun sum tshogs pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig rang la gnang ste/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su rang gis brjod/ bsgom don ni/ rang nyid kyai rdo rje dang*/ mtshan ldan gyi rten de nyid bdag med mar bsgom la/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs dkyus bzhin bya zhing*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rang nyid kyai rdo rje yab yum dang*/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi rgyud la dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa khyad par can skyes par bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag bzhi pa ni/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyed rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su rang gis brjod/ bsgom don ni/ dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub cing*/ skye 'gag la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu zhig gi ngang du cung zad bzhag rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag

de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi dngos su 'byor ram bsam kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang*/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor ām̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor ām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ā+ai/ o au/ am̐ aḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/

de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myangs la/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bas bde bas tshim par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṝ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams shing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsams la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes de yan chad rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgoms la/ rten dang brten pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems gzung*/ de nas gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi dmigs pa bsgoms pa'am/ 'bring po'i skabs ma bsgoms kyang rung*/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyi ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum po// sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// ces brjod/ bzlas pa byed na/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags 'phreng byung zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma nas zhugs te mgal me ltar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dha ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa ṣa bhu dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ adh+ma ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du dam̐ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzaya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ ban+dha ban+dha/

nā gāṣ+ṭa kan/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ sha trūn ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kartā ri he badz+rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying ngo*/ oṃ āḥ.a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥnam̐ badz+ra nai rāt+mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang yum gyi'o/ /oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ badz+ra bai tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ badz+ra puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ badz+ra sha wa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor gyi ste yab yum la ji tsam zlos pa'i bcu cha bzla/ yig brgya gsum mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gong du dkyil 'khor ma bsdus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim par

bsams la/ tho rangs kyi thun ma yin pa'i thun gzhan gsum gyi rjes sam/ gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i rjes su/ kol+la i reḍaṭhi a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ ka ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza i/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza i/ ha le kā liñja ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī si h+la/ kāp+pu ra lā i a i/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñja/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ ni ram̐ su am̐ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun du ru bā ṭa i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/ces smon lam btab/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma// rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sna la ser sna rdo rje ma// kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma// lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma// yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// spyi bor sku rdo rje ma// mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma// thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas srung ba byas la/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can kun// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin// rnam par dag cing rgyu gcig pa// bskal bzang spyod pas rnam rgyan te// thos nas gzhan la ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// bsgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog

/sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ sogs dang*/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// sogs dang*/ tshangs dang brgya byin rgyal po chen po bzhi// rang rang sder bcas mthu dang dpal ldan pa// ston pa'i dam chos skyong bar mdzad pa yi// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab bcom nas// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// sogs/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog/ //
ces brjod// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
